button.label: Selection
button.screentip: Apply the target font to math zones in the current selection.

button.label: Current slide
button.screentip: Apply the target font to every math zone on the current slide.

button.label: All slides
button.screentip: Apply the target font to every math zone in the active presentation.

toggleButton.label: Auto format
toggleButton.screentip: When selection changes, reformat math zones on the current slide.

button.label: Set font...
button.screentip: Change the target math font. Default: Latin Modern Math.

button.label: Restore Cambria
button.screentip: Restore every math zone in the active presentation to Cambria Math.
